newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metropolitan dividend approved after 2 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Metropolitan dividend approved after 2 yrs.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission had approved a 309 percent stock dividend declared by Metropolitan Insurance Company more than two years ago, documents submitted to the Philippine Stock Exchange on Friday showed.
Metropolitan is a rarely traded stock on the local bourse.
The SEC had authorised Metropolitan to distribute 310,187 common shares to shareholders as of March 18, 1997. It had also allowed Metropolitan to sell 91,000 shares to the shareholders.
The dividend was declared by its board on October 3, 1994. The SEC did not say why it took more than two years to decide on the issue. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
